adjustment_journal_refs_source.name: adjustment_journal_refs_source
adjustment_journal_refs_source.value: ("adjustment_journal_refs"."kind" <> 'home_use' OR "adjustment_journal_refs"."allocation_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("adjustment_journal_refs"."kind" <> 'depreciation' OR "adjustment_journal_refs"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL)

blue_deduction_answers_flags.name: blue_deduction_answers_flags
blue_deduction_answers_flags.value: "blue_deduction_answers"."double_entry" IN (0, 1) AND "blue_deduction_answers"."statements_attached" IN (0, 1) AND "blue_deduction_answers"."filed_on_time" IN (0, 1) AND "blue_deduction_answers"."e_tax" IN (0, 1) AND "blue_deduction_answers"."electronic_books" IN (0, 1)

import_batches_void.name: import_batches_void
import_batches_void.value: "import_batches"."status" = 'active' OR ("import_batches"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "import_batches"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL)
